project_name: Volleyball Recruiting CRM - Creative Tim Style

core_principles: Depth over Flatness: Use shadows and floating elements (Material Design)
Vibrant Accents: Pink/Salmon gradients against deep navy
Athletic Typography: Condensed headings for impact
Visual Hierarchy: Color is function. Pink = Active/Primary

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js to include the new custom colors (navy-900: #1a1f2e, navy-800: #202940, etc).
2. OVERWRITE the .dark variables in index.css with the values provided in 'colors.mapping'.
3. Refactor the Sidebar component to use the 'Floating' style with the pink gradient active state.
4. Create a reusable 'StatCard' component that implements the 'floating icon' pattern.
5. Ensure all text has sufficient contrast against the #1a1f2e background.
6. Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all numeric values and headers to give that sport/jersey feel.
7. DO NOT use purple accents anymore. Replace all purple with Pink (#ec407a) or Blue (#49a3f1).
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
